notes.title: Below Sunshade 3.3 Release
notes.notes:
Engine Fix: Resolved an RPG Maker MV engine issue that caused crashes and performance problems on monitors with refresh rates above 60Hz.
 New Passive Added: Explorer — Can now be obtained from the book located behind the Golem boss fight.
 Achievements Fixed:
    Secret Guardian Blade achievement now unlocks correctly.
    Achievement for helping Galan now triggers properly.
 Combat Fix: Resolved an issue where "On Attack" passives were not activating as intended.
 Balance Update: Increased Fire Ring's trigger chance from 10% to 15%. Buffed a few other items too.
 Map Update: The intro beach is now accessible only via the bottom-left exit of the camp map.
 Gallery Update: Added 6 previously missing scenes to the Gallery.

notes.title: Below Sunshade 3.2 Release
notes.notes:
Introduced 100+ new dialogue lines enhancing island dynamics.
     Optimized Parallax Shader to improve FPS in CG Scenes.
     Silver Sword now offers 25% Critical Hit Chance.
     Resolved the bug in the first Talitha Smalltalk Event.
     Corrected the Idrune bug that falsely accused players of lying, previously blocking an ending.

notes.title: 3.1 Release
notes.notes:
Hey folks,

here's a small patch fixing and changing some stuff! Thanks for the bug reports and suggestions everyone!

Changes & Fixes


 You are no longer stuck in the treehouse after Tulip leaves
 The passive skill Defender now grants defense as described
 Low FPS during CG Scenes fixed 
 The Naipei Quest "Worthy" now completes after giving her all three bounties 
 The Silver Sword got rebalanced
 Pressing F5 no longer restarts the game (RPG Maker why u do this)
 You no longer enter no-clip mode after picking up the Rapier
 We changed the visuals of some smaller areas to feel more natural

notes.title: Below Sunshade - Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

We're happy to announce the next and final chapter for Below Sunshade.

The Final Update will be released in Q4 2021 and of course free for everyone who owns the game as with our previous updates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/c32bd1256652b5bbae9b7199f00208045ccb544d.png

What's to expect?

This update will mainly focus on two things: Fixing Bugs and adding content that has been highly requested by our players.

Here's a quick rundown of what exactly you can expect

 Tons of bugfixes
 New ways to customize your playstyle
 New Adult Scenes
 New Outfits for our favorite characters
 More Playerbase customization
 A new NPC who functions as follower and who will join you in battle

We hope you're as excited as we are for this update. Below Sunshade was our first game on steam. We've released two big content updates (Heart of the Island and Milestones) so far and we're confident that this final update will be a great addition for the game.

Until then?

There's still a few months left, so let us know in this thread what content and features you want to see! In the meantime we're also releasing our second title on Steam: Arenus. Which has been in developement for over four years now. We'll also try to contact steam to get discount codes for Arenus for everyone who bought Below Sunshade. 

Thank you all for your support and trust.

Stay tuned!

- Kaliyo

notes.title: Below Sunshade: Milestones Release
notes.notes:
Hey folks! 

Hope you're ready for the Milestones update! Our biggest update for Below Sunshade so far.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/04e956cf6a25c3ddb7dedd8e50ed1e6fadde4298.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/1fa040fa2656e166ce4b44b3a371287dd6ff5598.png

Patchnotes

Introducing two new characters! Tulip and Galan. The sexy goblin alchemist and the young adventerous elf. Each one with their own storyline. Tulip is voiced by the talented Oolay-Tigher while Galan is voiced over by LewdAudio. Also DornVA returned for new Idrune Scenes.

Milestone System! Completing quests, dungeons, finding secrets and making progress results in Milestone points which can be used to unlock special skills.

Journal! Keep track of your quests. 

Combat Rework! You now have to equip skills to create your perfect build. On top of that you can find eight different new skills all around the island.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/e949e0b1ad8cedde95ef7a128979b93414877884.png


Familiar Faces! New content for Idrune including a super secret scene, also new Art for the Heart of the Island has been added.

Alchemy! Brew potions which grant you special effects for a whole day. 

Rework, Rework, Rework! Lots of smaller changes and additions: For example two teleportation circles which allow you to travel between the east and west ends of the island. 



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/9f7a0dc6e20f3e174d3cfe156945e922a8c39fd9.png

We hope you enjoy the new content!

Stay tuned

- Kal

notes.title: 1.1.0A Release
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

Thanks for your patience, we've fixed all dem bugs! Enjoy the game!

Bugfixes


 New Content has been added to 1.0.5 instead of 1.0.2 
 Repairing the ship now consumes energy as stated
 Vines can no longer be found. They were an item we added in early dev and have no purpose. There was one instance where they could still be found.
 You can now find "Cure disease potions" on the island which are also necessary for one of Idrune's mini quests
 Stuck image fixes for Naipei's new scene
 Missing image fixes for new Lizagon scene
 New Talitha Scene triggers as intended now
 Harmony Ending is now easier to achieve since you can now complete Idrune's "Cold" quest


Thank you for your support!

- Kal

notes.title: Below Sunshade: Update
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

Time for an update, this one comes with five new CG Scenes and quite a few bugfixes and polishing. Also thanks for your patience, took a few weeks longer than intended but we hope you like the new content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940202/881870689dd457f7dbd1e81f7defe7f2da3cd3fe.png

New Content
Story Mode! No more Day/Time Limit for those of you who want to unlock all the content.
New Talitha Scene! Encounter Talitha in a private situation.
New Idrune Scene! An additional CG Scene path added to Idrune's second sexy encounter.
New Naipei Scene! An additional CG Scene path for the Naipei & Fang ending
New Lizagon Scene! 


We hope you enjoy the new content! 
Thanks for your support and let us know what you would like to see in Below Sunshade!

- Kal
